invariants.rationale: The method executes a SavepointActionExecutor and returns its metadata, which should always be non-null upon successful creation.
A valid instantToSavepoint is required to identify the savepoint; null would not make sense for a save operation.
The savepoint metadata needs to record which user made the savepoint, making a null user invalid.
A HoodieEngineContext is required to execute the underlying action for savepointing.
A comment is supplied as an argument and is likely stored in the savepoint metadata; it does not make sense to save with a null comment.
